newsitem.title: SPAIN: Repsol plans 1.6 trillion ptas investment.
newsitem.headline: Repsol plans 1.6 trillion ptas investment.

text.p: Spain's Repsol expects to invest around 1.6 trillion pesetas in the next five years, chairman Alfonso Cortina said on Wednesday.
The energy firm also plans to cut costs by 50 billion pesetas over the same time frame.

Speaking to analysts at a presentation of this month's share offer, Cortina said: "Total investment (between 1997 and 2001) will be around 1.6 trillion pesetas with an expected rate of return of 17 percent."
"This will be complemented with a cost-cutting programme of around 10 billion pesetas per year, to reach (savings of) of 50 billion pesetas in 2001 versus 1996."
